items.text: Patriots ruled out RB TreVeyon Henderson for Sunday’s game in Germany against the Lions (illness).
items.why: Official ruling from Patriots injury report
items.implication: NE backfield flux; Stevenson also knee issue expected miss

items.text: Rams HC Sean McVay said the team will not place Puka Nacua on IR due to roster mechanics, but the WR will still be out for a significant period of time (knee/toe/MCL/PCL sprains).
items.why: McVay confirmation on roster mechanics and multi-week absence
items.implication: Rams lean more run-heavy; stash Nacua, look to backups/Atwell/Mumpfield and Kyren
items.opportunity: Rams negative PROE expected sans Nacua/Adams

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs will have surgery later this week on broken ring finger; could return as quickly as 2-3 weeks. IR not guaranteed; out vs Vikings (Week 10) before bye, then has a shot.
items.why: Sources on surgery timeline and IR decision Saturday
items.implication: Handcuff/backup opportunity short-term; monitor for early return post-bye

items.text: Keenan Allen and Josh Downs gone. Somebody still has to catch passes in Indy. Give me Tyler Warren in Week 10.
A.J. Brown loosens up at start of Thursday’s practice (ankle/knee). Good news after limited Wednesday; traveling to Germany, chance to play Week 10.
items.implication: Monitor for ACTIVE; upside WR2 if plays vs Lions

items.text: Sean McVay said WR Davante Adams returning after the Rams host the Packers in Week 12 is a realistic timeline.
items.implication: Stash Adams for late-season; scenarios where Adams returns before Nacua
items.opportunity: Rams WR depth still thin short-term

items.text: There are scenarios where Davante Adams (hamstring) plays and Puka Nacua (knee, toe) doesn't for some of fantasy's most important weeks. Discussed on ROS rankings show.
items.why: ROS show discussion of staggered returns
items.implication: Value Adams stash higher in some playoff scenarios; Nacua longer out

items.text: Chiefs listed QB Patrick Mahomes as a full participant in practice, putting him on track to play Sunday at Atlanta (elbow).

Vikings positive PROE despite bad QB play; pass rate could spike with Cousins as O'Connell wants to throw. Expect Rams more negative PROE without Nacua and Adams. Bengals let Chase/Higgins cook with healthy Burrow.
items.why: Last four games PROE analysis and team tendencies
items.implication: Jefferson upgrade with volume spike; Rams RBs benefit from run lean; Bengals WRs elite
items.opportunity: Pass rate and target share shifts

items.text: Kirk Cousins back in Minnesota. Across 54 games with Cousins, Jefferson averages 19.6 PPR. If you roster Jefferson, you LOVE that.
items.why: Historical production with Cousins and trade confirmation
items.implication: Jefferson vaults to strong WR1; start with confidence

items.text: Cousins to MIN upgrades Jefferson (career splits strong with him; pass rate likely up). Raiders Mendoza: Bowers still elite TE1 but lower floor; Jeanty biggest loser as checkdown king loses Cousins.
items.why: Detailed EPA, YPA, targets/route, historical data
items.implication: Jefferson WR1; Bowers hold; Jeanty downgrade slightly
items.opportunity: MIN more pass; LV growing pains, fewer checkdowns

items.text: Jordyn Tyson's time is coming, but it's not this week. I am CLOSING IT OUT on Tyson in week 10.
items.why: Timing not yet for expanded role

items.text: I am KEEPING IT OPEN on Jadarian Price, even with Charb back.
items.opportunity: Split or committee but Price involved

items.text: Worried about Brock Bowers with Fernando Mendoza at QB? Bowers put up monster numbers as rookie with O’Connell, Minshew and Ridder. He’ll be just fine.
items.implication: Hold/start Bowers as elite TE1; floor lower but still strong
